column1: # ZAP baseline rule overrides. Every IGNORE needs a reason; review when the flow changes.

column3: Non-Storable Content: HTML pages send Cache-Control no-store on purpose (personal and per-locale content).
Cookie Poisoning: ?lang= only ever sets the lang cookie to a normalised, enabled locale code (app.i18n.negotiation, tests/api/test_pages.py::test_unsupported_choice_is_ignored).

User Controllable HTML Element Attribute: only validated values are reflected (lang: enabled locale; week: normalised Monday; start: normalised slot time). Other parameters are dropped (app.web.templates.KEPT_QUERY_PARAMS); output is autoescaped.

Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens: forms are protected by Fetch Metadata (Sec-Fetch-Site) with an Origin fallback, OWASP's primary defence; see docs/threat-model.md and tests/api/test_booking_pages.py::test_cross_site_posts_are_refused.
